name: Enterprise Network Diagnostics Suite
description: Enterprise network latency and packet loss troubleshooting suite featuring an Executive NOC Dashboard, customizable themes, hop-by-hop MTR path analysis, subnet calculators, IP range scanning, protocol tools (DNS DoH, TCP Mathis/BDP, PMTUD MTU/MSS, BGP Looking Glass, VoIP MOS, IPv6), telemetry sound alerts, and exportable PDF diagnostic reports.
